answer.reason: Both make instrumentation and test and measurement products for industrial and medical/healthcare customers, and both are global multi-business industrial technology groups. AMETEK also has a material electromechanical business (motors, interconnects, specialty metals, thermal management) and aerospace/defense and research markets, with no match shown at Fortive. Fortive adds a software and healthcare sterilization/safety emphasis that AMETEK does not show. The overlap is partial on both product and customers, and the target's multi-business scope caps the grade at 1.

C:P1.2.text: Fortive is a diverse global team working together to innovate essential technologies for a safer, more productive world.

C:P1.3.text: Essential technologies for a safer, more productive world.

C:P1.4.text: We’re a global team, 10,000 strong, with a shared purpose and clear focus. We believe in the power of working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

C:P1.5.text: We solve critical challenges in industrial and healthcare settings. When safety and productivity matter most, our essential technologies deliver.

C:P1.7.text: Fortive technologies ensure medical device safety, protect against radiation exposure, and automate critical workflows. From infection prevention to intelligent automation, we help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

C:P1.9.text: Fortive technologies detect hazards, prevent failures before they happen, and resolve issues quickly. From gas detection to predictive maintenance, we help keep people safe and systems running.

C:P1.10.text: Though we’re spread around the globe, we’re united by a powerful continuous improvement mindset. At Fortive, anything is possible.

C:P1.11.text: We see a sustainable future as a world that’s safe and productive for all. We're more focused than ever on protecting the planet, investing in our teams and communities, and working and sourcing responsibly.

C:P1.12.text: For you. For us. For growth.

C:P1.13.text: We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

C:P1.14.text: We believe that prioritizing trust, sustainability, and positive impact creates long-term value.

C:P2.1.text: Our Work | Intelligent Operating Solutions | Fortive

C:P2.2.text: Our forward-looking companies lead the way in software-enabled workflows, applied intelligence, advanced analytics, and other rapidly evolving technologies.

C:P2.3.text: Essential technologies for a safer, more productive world

C:P2.4.text: We partner with our customers to drive the future of industrial and healthcare safety and productivity. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions.

C:P2.5.text: Our operating companies are known for their industry-leading positions and trusted brands. We group them into two strategic segments to focus on specific technologies and markets, but at Fortive the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. Our strong culture and the power of the Fortive Business System (FBS) catalyze innovation and growth across the portfolio.

C:P2.6.text: At hospitals, healthcare facilities, and laboratories, delivering exceptional care efficiently while navigating rapid change is more important than ever. They need advanced technologies to ensure that critical safety standards are met, instruments are operating at peak performance, and complex procedures are followed accurately in a dynamic environment.

C:P2.7.text: These businesses help raise the standard of care globally, keep healthcare settings safe, and ensure that providers can focus on the best possible care for their patients.

C:P2.9.text: From smart office buildings and universities to high-tech construction sites and warehouses, these businesses deliver advanced instrumentation and software to ensure safety and compliance, improve energy efficiency, and optimize performance.
